Uploading big PDFs just got a lot easier

But still only 128 MB max request size on Claude API
history.author: ClaudeDevs
history.source_text:
We've raised the max request size for Messages and Token Counting on the Claude API from 32 MB to 128 MB.

Image-heavy requests like long computer-use sessions and big PDFs were previously hitting 32 MB with plenty of context window left. Now you get ~4x more room. https://t.co/KpZrMgWwmH
